description: Frontend performance: extend Vite code splitting, add React.memo to high-frequency list components, add useDebounce to remaining search inputs, add AbortController to hook-based data fetches, and add loading skeletons. Write docs/frontend_performance.md. No backend changes.
steps: 1. In frontend/vite.config.ts, extend the manualChunks configuration to add: 'vendor-ui': ['lucide-react'], 'feature-kitchen': chunk condition for kitchen pages, 'feature-pos': chunk condition for POS/operations pages, 'feature-reports': chunk condition for reporting pages, 'feature-accounting': chunk condition for accounting pages. Use function-based manualChunks (id: string) => string | undefined to group by directory prefix under src/pages/. The existing vendor-react, vendor-query, vendor-charts chunks stay unchanged.

2. Add React.memo to the following components that render in large lists and receive stable props: frontend/src/components/ui/StatCard.tsx (already memoized — verify and keep), frontend/src/pages/orders/OrderListPage.tsx row component if one exists, frontend/src/pages/inventory/InventoryItemsPage.tsx row component if one exists, frontend/src/pages/notifications/NotificationCenter.tsx notification row component. Use React.memo() wrapping the export, with explicit prop comparison only if the component has complex object props.

3. Add useDebounce to every page that has a search input field but does not yet import useDebounce. Find these by searching for onChange handlers on <input> or <Input> elements in src/pages/**/*.tsx that filter API params. Priority pages: frontend/src/pages/billing/BillListPage.tsx, frontend/src/pages/payments/PaymentHistoryPage.tsx, frontend/src/pages/kitchen/KitchenHistory.tsx, frontend/src/pages/inventory/StockHistoryPage.tsx. Pattern: const debouncedSearch = useDebounce(searchInput, 300); use debouncedSearch in the query params object passed to the API hook.

4. Add AbortController-based request cancellation to the custom hooks in frontend/src/hooks/ that use axios directly (useOrders.ts, useMenu.ts, useReporting.ts, useKitchen.ts, useNotifications.ts). In each hook's useEffect or queryFn, create const controller = new AbortController(); pass { signal: controller.signal } to the axios call; return () => controller.abort() from the useEffect cleanup. For TanStack Query hooks, pass signal from the queryFn's context argument to axios.

5. Create a SkeletonCard component at frontend/src/components/ui/SkeletonCard.tsx that renders a pulsing placeholder matching the StatCard dimensions (height, border-radius). Create a SkeletonTable component at frontend/src/components/ui/SkeletonTable.tsx that renders N rows of pulsing placeholder cells. Use Tailwind's animate-pulse utility.

6. Apply SkeletonCard in frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: while KPI data is loading (isLoading from TanStack Query), render 4 SkeletonCards instead of StatCards. Apply SkeletonTable in frontend/src/pages/orders/OrderListPage.tsx and frontend/src/pages/billing/BillListPage.tsx while data is loading.
7. Write frontend/docs/frontend_performance.md documenting: chunk split strategy, which components are memoized and why, debounce usage map, AbortController pattern, skeleton components.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build in frontend/ exits 0 with no TypeScript errors
npm run lint in frontend/ exits 0 with max-warnings 0
vite build output shows separate chunk files for vendor-ui, feature-kitchen, feature-pos, feature-reports, feature-accounting
useDebounce is imported in BillListPage.tsx, PaymentHistoryPage.tsx, and at least 2 other pages
SkeletonCard.tsx and SkeletonTable.tsx exist in frontend/src/components/ui/
